summary: The blind compare flagged nothing: all 100 keys matched an independent solve, with no ambiguous clozes or disputed judgements. The full read found no wrong keys or pinyin errors; fixes were one self-contradictory judge sentence (062), two loose English cues (065, 082), one level, one random distractor, and three why texts with muddled or false mnemonics. Left as judgement calls: rare 汨 as the distractor in 041, and 锻炼 (HSK 3) counted as level 3 in 009 because the sentence is a two-clause report.

look-alike-characters-02-019.note: why tidied: dropped the odd 'rest of the body' gloss; 身休 is simply not a word.

look-alike-characters-02-035.note: why rewritten: removed the confusing 'sound-sun' mnemonic and spelled out both components.

look-alike-characters-02-052.note: Level raised 1 to 2: 像 'resemble' is HSK 3.

look-alike-characters-02-062.note: Wrong-sentence context was self-contradictory (entrance at the back door, 'please go in here'); rewrote to 入口在后面，我们从那儿进去吧.

look-alike-characters-02-065.note: English cue said 'get my friends together', which overstates 找朋友一起去; now 'ask some friends to go hiking with me'.

look-alike-characters-02-082.note: 汽车 with cue 'take a car' was loose (坐汽车 often means bus); made it 公共汽车 with cue 'taking the bus'.

look-alike-characters-02-087.note: Dropped random distractor 犬 (not a real confusion at HSK 1); why rewritten to match the remaining options.

look-alike-characters-02-095.note: why claimed 兄 shows 'two brothers'; 兄 is one brother. Rewritten.
